name: drive-files-to-zapier-table

deploy.description: Log every new file and folder on the Work.Flowers HQ shared drive into [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders, keyed on the Drive object id. Source of truth: https://github.com/work-flowers/zapier-sdk/tree/main/drive-files-to-zapier-table
deploy.enable_on_publish_note: Parked at first publish so it could not double-write alongside the then-live classic Zap. Cutover done 2026-08-22; kept as the record of why v1 shipped disabled. A republish carries the CURRENT enabled state forward (read off Zapier), so this no longer affects anything.

trigger.trigger_note: Google Drive POLLING trigger over the whole Work.Flowers HQ shared drive (no `folder`, same as the classic Zap), 4 subfolder levels deep. Param shapes follow `list-trigger-input-fields`: includeSubfolders is BOOLEAN and subfolderDepth INTEGER, so the classic Zap's string "4" is a real 4 here. Durable triggers have no polling-interval field, so it polls at the account default — matching the classic Zap's polling_interval_override of 0. No external URL to cut over.

connections_note: None needed. The workflow only touches Zapier Tables, which require no connection; the Google Drive connection is bound to the TRIGGER (trigger.authentication_id), not to a step.

tables.01K5ZN0AGNDHS4C424XEDCWJZY: [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders — OWNED by this workflow (row creation). f1 ID, f2 Kind, f3 Name, f4 Parent ID. drive-file-renamed-to-zapier-table keeps f3/f4 current afterwards.

replaces_classic_zap: Log New Google Drive Files and Folders in Zapier Table

cutover.classic_zap_disabled: 2026-08-22 — confirmed by Dennis. Not machine-verifiable: classic Zaps are exposed by neither the SDK CLI nor the MCP connector.
cutover.status: complete — this durable is the only thing logging Drive objects into [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders.

behaviour_changes: The classic Zap created a row unconditionally, so a re-trigger on the same Drive object duplicated it. The durable upserts on the Drive id: unseen ids are created, a known id is left alone, and a known id whose name or parent drifted is repaired.
description: Google Drive polling trigger (new file/folder anywhere on Work.Flowers HQ) -> upsert the object into [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders, keyed on the Drive object id.
